name: v2.5.26-dev.2
body:
## What's new in v2.5.26-dev.2

- feat(kiosk): streaming-service favourite toast + CD eject to root & disc watch
- fix(kiosk): keep remote spotlight on the Favourites menu-tile grid
- fix(audio): force large ALSA output buffer on the built-in player
- feat(kiosk): Eject button on the CD album page; flush pending alpha30 work
- feat(cd): ESP-style osmium-cdread replaces cdda2wav for live CD playback
- fix(kiosk): album favourite button shows only the heart, no label
- feat(kiosk): mappable CD-changer disc +/- remote actions + Qobuz album page polish
- fix(kiosk): restore radio station logos in menu-tile lists
- feat(kiosk): make the inserted CD a first-class album everywhere
- feat(kiosk): polish first-class streaming plugins (menu tiles, album detection, tracklists)
- feat(kiosk): make streaming plugins first-class like the local library
- feat(kiosk): show the CD album cover and hide the plugin's Eject item
- feat(kiosk): preview editions with tracklists in the CD rip window
- feat(kiosk): run the CD rip in the background with a progress notification
- feat(kiosk): add a CD Player tile and auto-install the CDplayer plugin
- feat(website): refine the Quick start guide tutorial
- feat(website): add a Quick start guide popup to the hero
- ui(kiosk): add a Favourites tile and put Favourites + Local Library first
- fix(kiosk): make the Spotify sign-in QR scannable (short LAN redirect)
- feat(kiosk): sign in to streaming services from the kiosk
- ui(kiosk): show plugin artwork and expose the native context menu (Qobuz parity)
- ui(kiosk): fix CD changer side-by-side layout and source tile labels
- ui(kiosk): sources tile home for the Music tab, remove the Radio tab
- audio: make the DAC-gone pause on Lyrion authoritative with verify+retry
- companion: release 1.0.18 (versionCode 41)
- companion: add a gold search FAB on the kiosk Music tab
- audio: pause the built-in player on Lyrion when its USB DAC is gone
- gpu: skip nouveau only when an Intel display GPU is present
- ui: toggle an adopted disk's network share from Sources (Qt + web admin)
- sources: let an adopted internal/USB disk opt out of SMB sharing
- wifi: bind Broadcom wl also to BCM4350 (43a3) and BCM43142 (4365)
- website: make the 'general enquiries' contact line a visible callout
- website: let the support form take several files (5 MB total)
- website: send the support-form notice via Resend
- website: replace the support mailto box with a report form
- audio: real DAC-rate readout, glanceable upsample ceilings, onboard S/PDIF switches
- ui: light the BitPerfect LED only on a positive bitperfect verdict
- i18n: add German (de) as third UI language, with a QWERTZ on-screen keyboard
- audio: absolute target-rate picker for player-side PCM upsampling
- cd: tolerate flaky USB drives in the CD Player plugin; clear automounts before ripping
- ci: pass HIFI_OS_NO_APT through sudo in the OTA idempotency test
- os-update: mask bluetooth.service after bluez is installed, not before
- audio: box players always convert PCM player-side; drop convert_where
- audio: always upsample PCM player-side; clamp DSD to a per-DAC ceiling
- web admin: forward the System tweaks route through webui_server
- audio: PCM→DSD conversion location, FLAC upsampling fix, DSD512 ceiling, system tweaks
- audio: follow a USB DAC hotplugged in or out so the player stops crash-looping
- audio: force a player's DSD mode to auto when it converts PCM to DSD
- lms: install the bundled plugin into the vendor Plugins dir, not InstalledPlugins
- web admin: keep only third-party players in the External players list
- audio: drive per-player conversion entirely through the Osmium Convert plugin
- lms: add Osmium Convert plugin (single mechanism for per-player conversion)
- web admin: forward the external-player convert routes through webui_server
- website: point companion download to 1.0.17
- companion: promote 1.0.17 to stable (bespoke album page, Qt-aligned settings)
- kiosk: make the settings group tiles the same size as the section tiles
- audio: three-mode per-player conversion (Off / PCM upsample / DSD), external players too
- companion: bundle native debug symbols (SYMBOL_TABLE) in release AAB
- kiosk: make library favorites (db: queries) work in the Album view (#125)
- boot: stop blocking Bluetooth-over-USB, blacklist only (#126)
- sources: allow copying a music source onto the second disk (#127)
- site: point companion download to 1.0.15
- companion: promote 1.0.15 to stable (kiosk UI, dual-proxy)
- companion: align Settings tree with the Qt kiosk
- cleanup: drop the dead pre-kiosk UI (home-screen widget, old browse home)
- kiosk: album library as a grid like Qt, Radio/Apps lists keep their icons
- release: companion 1.0.17-svil1 (versionCode 38)
- kiosk: bespoke album page, per-row play button, open animations
- kiosk: show icons in the Radio/Apps lists built from radioss_loop/appss_loop
- release: bump companion to 1.0.16-svil1 (versionCode 37)
- kiosk: fill Radio/Apps tabs from radios/apps commands, not the home menu
- companion: bump to 1.0.15-svil1 (versionCode 36) for a dev build
- companion: open Radio and Apps from their real home-menu item
- audio: list onboard codecs aplay -l hides, and dump aplay/mixer in the bundle
- docs: add AGENTS.md with Graphiti memory protocol and working rules
- tests: stub the Bluetooth radio probe in the speaker tests
- companion: empty item lists show a message; settings as tile groups
- kiosk: album/artist queue buttons confirm only what Lyrion accepted (#120)
- ci: use GITHUB_REF_NAME for companion artifact name
- Fix version extraction from GitHub tag
- companion: open Radio and Apps tabs inside the kiosk shell
- player: resume only the internal player on boot, keep speakers paused (#124)
- kiosk: keep the breadcrumb trail from running over "Back" (#113)
- kiosk: let a real keyboard type into the on-screen keyboard (#114)
- player: pause all local players on shutdown instead of resuming on boot (#124)
- bluetooth: don't offer the switch when there is no adapter
- files: check free space when copying to the second disk too
- kiosk: remind to remove the USB stick in the power dialog
- kiosk: confirm the album/artist queue buttons with a toast
- kiosk: show the basename for a folder literally named "0"
- signal path: a remote player's path is unknown, not processed
- files: name the roots System disk / Second disk in the folder picker
- companion: browse the library inside the kiosk shell (M2)
- companion: decouple browse row-stack from the concrete list activity
- website: count Ko-fi "Tip" donations in the supporters strip
- lyrion: repair stray ownership of the state tree on every start
- companion: home tiles set an empty players array so browsing doesn't crash
- companion: build tile header items via the record constructor (no NPE)
- companion: don't crash the shell's mini player when there is no action bar
- companion: land on the kiosk shell as home, not the old server menu
- companion: kiosk-style shell with a tabbed home of category tiles (M1)
- kiosk: rename the library "Artists" category to "Album Artists"
- kiosk: return to where you were when leaving a section, and a working Back in Settings
- signal path: decide lossless by codec, never from the absence of a lossy tag
- web admin: settings front page is a grid of square tiles
- kiosk: a real keyboard types into the on-screen keyboard (space, enter and backspace stay its own, #114); the breadcrumb trail stops short of the buttons and keeps its end in view (#113)
- kiosk settings: front page is a grid of square tiles (six macro sections, each opening a grid of its sections); interface resolution falls back to the biggest mode the monitor lists when none matches its aspect (21:9 panels)
- kiosk: adapt the interface to ultrawide and bar screens (canvas up to 6:1, 440-point canvas for bar panels, wide Now Playing, home, albums, CD changer, settings); original VU panel kept
- kiosk (ultrawide test): fullscreen VU plate grows in width in 7 slices, meters grouped, title in a header
- WIP ultrawide: fullscreen VU = long plate (stretched middle), track info on the plate
- WIP ultrawide: bar Now Playing clock next to the left buttons
- WIP ultrawide: CD changer big on the right in wide canvases; test-only ui-test-bar
- WIP ultrawide: bar player text centred, play button under the title
- WIP ultrawide: bar player controls centred, volume on its own row
- WIP ultrawide: bar Now Playing = player | VU | album
- WIP ultrawide: bar Now Playing = cover | VU | title and controls
- WIP ultrawide: 440-point canvas for bar panels (home, panel, albums, Now Playing)
- WIP ultrawide: Now Playing stacked right column (header, big VU, bottom controls)
- WIP ultrawide test: ui-test-aspect override
- WIP ultrawide test: canvas up to 6:1, wide/ultra levels, 3-column Now Playing, home/album columns
- ci: a dev's changelog starts from the previous dev, not from its last alpha
- website: a beta version to download, ISO and USB image
- vu store: Blue Neon v2, the meter sits higher in Now Playing
- vu store: Blue Neon, a backlit neon meter
- ci: CodeQL once a night instead of on every push
- ci: keep the A/B image artifact one day, not fourteen
- website: the F-Droid index is not a download, only the APKs are counted
- website: the same client fetching the same file within an hour counts once
- companion: 1.0.14
- companion: three crashes from the Play console fixed
- ci: releases start the Cloudflare Pages deploy themselves
- website: in line with main
